dishes.name: Adana kebabı
dishes.desc: Hand-minced lamb with tail fat and red pepper pressed on wide skewers and grilled over charcoal. The city's famous dish, often eaten with şalgam and onion salad.

dishes.name: Şırdan dolması
dishes.desc: Lamb stomach stuffed with rice and spices, boiled and fried. A classic of old Adana tradition.

dishes.name: Fellah köftesi
dishes.desc: A Çukurova dish of bulgur and meat dumplings in a rich tomato and pepper sauce. Served in local lokantas.

dishes.name: Bici bici
dishes.desc: A cold street dessert of starch jelly in rosewater syrup with crushed ice. A cooling summer speciality of Adana.
